title: React performance transitions deferred values profiling and compiler
concepts: Start performance work by measuring a real user-visible bottleneck; frequent renders alone do not prove a performance problem.
React rendering is usually inexpensive. Reduce unnecessary expensive calculations and avoid blocking urgent interactions before adding caches or complexity.

Manual memoization caches a component result, calculation, or function identity when dependencies are unchanged. It is an optimization, not a correctness guarantee, and custom equality checks can be more costly or incorrect.

Transitions classify updates as non-urgent interruptible rendering work while urgent input can continue. Deferred values let part of the UI temporarily use an older value while a newer render proceeds.
The Profiler measures committed render work. Browser developer tools and React DevTools help identify where time is spent; production profiling requires a profiling-enabled build.

React Compiler performs build-time optimizations and can automatically memoize components, values, and functions. It does not replace profiling or excuse impure components or missing dependency correctness.
